meta.summary: Zara: chat assistant and newsletter prompts, plus campaign picture and social link controls (desktop only verified)
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 on the desktop US storefront only (zara.com/us, desktop UA, headless Chrome, logged out); counts were taken on the saved rendered DOM. The iPhone UA capture returned an empty page shell (Zara serves a blank body to the automated phone browser), so nothing was verified on a phone and the recipe's desktop fixture is the only real one: there is no real.html (phone) fixture.

Zara's home page is a stack of full-screen campaign sliders (`slider-spot`, one per universe such as Woman, Man, Kids, Beauty) built with readable BEM class names. LIVE counts: `#chat-container` 1 and `#chat-notifications` 1 (both empty containers for the chat assistant), `.slider-spot-slide-footer-marketing__newsletter` 10, `#homeSocialFooter` 10 (one per footer slide), `.slider-spot__slide-background` 45 (the media layer of each slide; its image or video had not loaded in the capture, so the blur and hide act on the container).

Not targeted on purpose: the category menu, the Cookies settings link, the cart and the logon link. The original generic rules matched nothing on the live page and are kept. NOT verified: phone layout, product listing and product pages (the recipe was only checked on the home page), other countries' storefronts, logged-in state.
